steps.label: DEPENDENT

steps.label: INDEPENDENT

eyebrow: A real example, already in the warehouse
code:
-- What a "Reseller Sales" mart's core query looks like —
SELECT r.ResellerName, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalResellerSales
FROM dbo.FactResellerSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimReseller AS r ON r.ResellerKey = f.ResellerKey
GROUP BY r.ResellerName
ORDER BY TotalResellerSales DESC;
caption: A narrow slice, focused on ONE business function — reseller sales, not internet sales too.

eyebrow: Why bother, instead of querying the warehouse directly
code:
-- A full warehouse: dozens of tables, every subject, every team
-- A mart: exactly what ONE team needs — faster, simpler
caption: Less to wade through, less contention with every other team's queries.
